title: RNZ
tagline: Radio New Zealand's live stations, news and podcasts in one clean, ad-free app.
summary: The RNZ app streams RNZ National, Concert, Pacific and Parliament live, alongside breaking news, on-demand programmes and podcasts. Listeners can bookmark, build a play queue and download episodes to listen offline, with nothing getting in the way of the content.
label: RNZ

title: 2degrees
tagline: Letting hundreds of thousands of New Zealanders manage their mobile account themselves.
summary: 2degrees wanted customers to sort out their own accounts instead of calling the contact centre. The app lets people check their balance and data, top up, buy add-ons and change plans, across many plan types and account structures, with playful illustrations and a Kiwi tone of voice. It smashed every KPI set for it, and won a Best Awards Gold, a Good Design award and a Webby Honouree.
label: 2degrees

title: TVNZ+ and 1News
tagline: New Zealand's free-to-air broadcaster, live and on demand for over two million people.
summary: TVNZ+ streams live and on-demand TV, and 1News delivers the news with layouts driven from the backend through modular, API-rendered components. Keeping more than ten third-party platforms and SDKs healthy, including Segment and Nielsen analytics and Split A/B testing, took steady proactive maintenance. The work won a Silver at the Best Awards.
platform: iOS, Apple TV, Android and web
label: TVNZ+ and 1News

title: Drive Go
tagline: New Zealand's first learn-to-drive app, built to make roads safer.
summary: Built for NZ Transport Agency Waka Kotahi with ACC and the Ministry of Education, Drive Go guides learner drivers along a road-shaped path with city or rural routes, playful award badges and Lottie animations. Lessons were reordered to put crash-prevention skills first, and the app includes machine-learning licence scanning. It won Gold at the Best Awards and a Good Design Gold.
label: Drive Go

title: Sharesies
tagline: Leading Sharesies from the start of its mobile journey to a scalable native platform.
summary: I joined Sharesies at the beginning of its mobile journey and owned the iOS platform: building the team, setting the roadmap and choosing our practices. I worked closely with leadership to advocate for a considered shift towards mobile. Our principles of cohesion and simplicity shaped how the apps joined existing systems, and they were built in SwiftUI with an easy to understand, modular structure.
label: Sharesies

title: Goodnotes
tagline: Building new features for the Goodnotes Education team, fully in SwiftUI.
summary: Since moving to Amsterdam I have worked fully remote in the Education team at Goodnotes, owning and building new features end to end with developers, product and designers. Goodnotes is a large, complex, cross-platform codebase that people use for long stretches of time, so continuous releases stay high quality through strong testing and QA practices. I have also helped teammates bring AI workflows into their daily work while keeping the human touch.
label: Goodnotes
